column1: # BaseMenuScreen batch: menu chrome + widget factories (all 23 rows named).
# Abstract hooks are the menu contract: isBackEnabled decides the Back/Exit label (line 297),
# createContent fills the content container from layout(), handleWidgetAction and handleAction
# map a widget or an action id onto the next screen.
# a(Container,NinePatchImage,ScrollPane[,int[,boolean]]) and its Widget overload are one
# overload family (setupScrollPane). d()/e() reveal the Website+Forums and Purchase buttons
# unless the market is ChinaMobile/iWin/JoyMoa or the license is already bought.
